summary: __thiscall setter that records a display mode value at this+0x19C (this[103]): a2 of 0x20000, 0x40000 or 0x80000 is stored as-is, any other value stores 0. In every path it ORs the 0x10000 flag into this+0xEC (this[59]) to signal that a UI update is needed, and returns the resulting flag word. Called by sub_4FCC30.

local_names.this: object whose display-mode and flags fields are written
local_names.a2: incoming display mode selector (0x20000, 0x40000 or 0x80000, else cleared)
local_names.result: this+0xEC with the 0x10000 flag OR'd in

operations.description: When a2 equals 0x20000, store 0x20000 into this+0x19C.
When a2 equals 0x40000, store 0x40000 into this+0x19C.
In the else path, store 0x80000 into this+0x19C when a2 equals 0x80000, otherwise store 0.
In every path, OR the 0x10000 flag into this+0xEC (this[59]) and return the combined value, signaling that a UI update is needed.
Returns the OR'd flag value held in result.
Called by sub_4FCC30 to set the display mode on its owning object.
